Resumen de lo acordado antes de redactar la especificación:

DECIDIDO
• Nuevas rutas POST /listings/:id/pause y POST /listings/:id/resume; una publicación pausada tiene status `paused`, la reanudada vuelve a `active`.
• Pueden pausar/reanudar el vendedor dueño y cualquier admin.
• Pausada: oculta en la búsqueda para todos; la consulta directa GET /listings/:id la sigue devolviendo a cualquiera, con status paused.
• Pausada: los pedidos nuevos se rechazan; los pedidos ya existentes quedan intactos.
• Al reanudar conserva exactamente sus puntos de ranking; su posición se recalcula frente a las demás.
• Pausar una ya pausada o reanudar una ya activa responde éxito sin cambios.

VALORES PROPUESTOS (sigón las convenciones actuales de la API)
• Pausar/reanudar responden 200 con la publicación actualizada.
• Sin usuario → 401 `unauthenticated`; usuario que no es dueño ni admin → 403; publicación inexistente → 404 `listing_not_found`.
• Pedido sobre una pausada → 409 `listing_paused`.
• Las rutas nuevas se publican también en la tabla de rutas del servidor (hoy, una ruta que no está ahí da 404 en producción aunque los tests pasen).

FUERA DE ALCANCE
• Pausa programada o con fecha de fin, pausas en lote, historial de pausas, notificaciones, interfaz gráfica, cambios al cálculo del ranking.

DECISIONES ABIERTAS: ninguna.

TAMAÑO (mi clasificación, corrígela si no estás de acuerdo): estándar — añade un estado nuevo y cambia varios flujos (búsqueda, pedidos). Fija el límite en 3 rondas de revisión por fase.

questions.question:
Prompt para la especificación (texto completo, en inglés):

---
Feature: Pause and resume a listing

WHY: Sellers sometimes need to take a listing off the market temporarily (e.g. out of stock, on vacation) without deleting it and without losing the ranking it has earned through orders. Today a listing can only be active.

WHAT:
1. Add two actions to the listings API: `POST /listings/:id/pause` and `POST /listings/:id/resume`. A paused listing has status `paused`; resuming it sets status back to `active`.
2. Who may act: the seller who owns the listing, and any admin. Any other authenticated user (another seller, a buyer) is refused with 403. A request without a known user is refused with 401 `unauthenticated`. An unknown listing id answers 404 `listing_not_found`.
3. Success answers 200 with the updated listing.
4. Repeated actions: pausing an already paused listing, or resuming an already active listing, answers 200 with the listing unchanged.
5. Ranking is preserved: pausing and resuming never change the listing's rank score. After resuming, the listing keeps exactly the score it had; its position in search is recomputed against the other listings (it may land lower if others gained score meanwhile).
6. While paused:
   - it is hidden from search results (`GET /listings`) for everyone;
   - fetching it directly (`GET /listings/:id`) still returns it to anyone, with status `paused`;
   - new orders on it are refused with 409 `listing_paused` (so its rank score cannot grow while paused);
   - orders that already existed when it was paused are left untouched and remain visible in `GET /orders` as today.
7. The two new routes must be reachable through the running server's published route table, not only in tests (today a route missing from that table answers 404 in production even when tests pass).

References: none — build on the existing listings API.

Non-goals (out of scope for this feature): scheduled or time-limited pauses, bulk pause/resume, a history of pauses, notifications, any UI, changes to how the rank score is computed.

Open decisions: none.
---

Este es el borrador completo del objetivo (goal.md), tal cual quedaría:

# Goal: pause and resume a listing without losing its rank

## Goal condition
`npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` exit 0, and against the running server (`npm start`, which goes through the published route table), `POST /listings/:id/pause` by the owning seller returns 200 with the listing showing `status: "paused"` and an unchanged `rankScore`, and a later `POST /listings/:id/resume` returns 200 with `status: "active"` and the same `rankScore`.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-1 — `POST /listings/:id/pause` by the listing's owning seller sets its status to `paused` and answers 200 with the full updated listing. Its `rankScore` is unchanged.
- AC-2 — `POST /listings/:id/resume` by the owning seller sets a paused listing's status back to `active` and answers 200 with the full updated listing. Its `rankScore` is the same value it had when paused.
- AC-3 — An admin can pause and resume any listing, with the same results as AC-1 and AC-2.
- AC-4 — Pause and resume are rejected with an error response, leaving the listing unchanged, when: the caller is not identified; the listing does not exist; the caller is neither the owning seller nor an admin (another seller, or a buyer). The exact status codes and error codes are the implementer's choice and follow the API's existing error convention (`{"error": "<code>"}`).
- AC-5 — Repeated actions: pausing an already-paused listing, or resuming an already-active listing, answers 200 with the listing unchanged.
- AC-6 — A paused listing does not appear in `GET /listings` results (with or without `q`). After resume it appears again, ordered by its preserved `rankScore` like any other listing; its position is not guaranteed to be the one it had before (others may have overtaken it).
- AC-7 — `GET /listings/:id` on a paused listing answers 200 to anyone, showing `status: "paused"`.
- AC-8 — `POST /listings/:id/orders` on a paused listing is rejected with 409 `{"error": "listing_paused"}`; no order is created and the listing's `rankScore` does not change.
- AC-9 — Pausing a listing does not change any existing order on it.
- AC-10 — Both new routes are reachable through the running server: they are added to the published route table in `src/gateway.ts` (today any route not listed there answers 404 before reaching the app).

## Constraints
- Existing endpoints keep their current behavior for active listings; existing tests keep passing.
- The listing status type gains `paused`; new listings still start `active` with `rankScore` 0.
- Ranking rules (`src/ranking.ts`) are unchanged.
- No new dependencies.

## Out of scope
- Scheduled pauses or pauses with an end date.
- Pause history or audit trail.
- Notifications to buyers or sellers.
- Any behavior change to other endpoints beyond AC-6, AC-7 and AC-8.

## References
- None given by the user. Follow the existing conventions of this API (`src/listings.ts`, `src/orders.ts`, `src/http.ts`, `src/gateway.ts`).

## Decisions behind this goal
- Hidden from search; visible by id; orders rejected; existing orders untouched; owner + admin; repeated actions succeed unchanged; rankScore preserved, position not guaranteed; error codes for AC-4 at the implementer's discretion (all user decisions at intake).
- AC-8's 409 `listing_paused` — the user delegated this choice ("Te lo dejo a ti"); chosen for consistency with AC-7 (assumed — A1).
